newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Grain falls 10 pc on poor results.
newsitem.headline: Grain falls 10 pc on poor results.

text.p: Ceylon Grain Elevators Ltd was down 10 percent, or one rupee, at 9.25 rupees, on early selling of 42,300 shares.
"Recently released results were as bad as expected, which is why there is a lot of selling," a local broker said.
Nine-month results to September 30, 1996, showed the company made a loss of 52.7 million rupees, against a profit of 130.8 million in the same period in 1995.
The company, which mills animal feed and produces day-old chicks, was hit by rising world food grain prices and power cuts in early 1996. -- Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
